evidence_pattern: the key is a transcription error — no document carries that date
designer_notes: The agent is right and the key is wrong. This is the cheapest dispute to detect and the one most worth detecting automatically: the key names a date on which the chart holds NO DOCUMENT AT ALL, which is decidable without reading a word of clinical text. An evaluation that cannot catch this one will not catch any.

STORE.390.date_of_initial_diagnosis.why: REGISTRY VALUE, AND IT IS WRONG. Every document in the chart places the diagnosis at 2020-06-14; no document exists on 2020-07-14 and nothing supports it. The month digit was mistyped.

STORE.400_522_523.site_histology_behavio.why: Tissue diagnosis present in the chart.

key_dispute.why: Pathology, the oncology note and the index imaging all fall in June 2020. The chart contains no document dated 2020-07-14.
key_dispute.harm_if_missed: a correct run is recorded as a failure, and repeated, the measured accuracy of a working system decays toward the abstractor's error rate
